query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  COUNT(coach_id) as has_coach_id,
  SUM(CAST(feePerQuarter AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_fee
FROM students
WHERE coach_id IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1;
